settings.headline: What happens after you eat matters.
settings.intro: INCHY is whole-food nutrition organised around satiety. FORM1 is our unflavoured sacha inchi powder: stir it into food you already eat. Protein and fibre from the same seed, grown in Colombia by farmers we know by name.
settings.note: U.S. launch coming soon. Join the list for launch news and an email when ordering opens.

settings.heading: FORM1 · The pouch
settings.copy: An unflavoured sacha inchi preparation for yoghurt, oats and everyday food. Our proprietary process transforms the seed into a powder while keeping its protein and fibre together.

Sacha inchi has been eaten for thousands of years. But the organised supply chain we needed didn’t exist.

So we’re helping build it.

settings.association_answer: Premium sacha inchi doesn't come from a spec sheet. It comes from the right altitude, the right soil and the right farmers. There was no organised market for this crop, so together with growers in northeast Colombia we helped establish an association to formalise it: direct purchasing, consistent quality, a reason to plant.
